# Episode NNN — Master shot plan

## Production metadata

Record episode ID, status, version, languages, aspect ratio, target duration, narration end, engine, segment duration/count, reference limit, inherited locked specs, and approval state.

## Narrative guardrails

List factual qualifications, prohibited implications, sensitive depictions, and required editorial separations.

## Narration timing master

Map actual narration timestamps to story events. Use timing derived from the approved voice.

## Global plan

Define pacing, camera grammar, character motion, environment motion, text restrictions, audio policy, and reference allocation.

## Per-clip section

For each profile-defined generation block include:

- clip ID and time range
- narrative purpose
- reference allocation and ordered `<Picture N>` mapping within the profile limit
- environment and palette
- target beat count
- for each shot: local time, narration alignment, framing, visible content, one main action, camera movement, secondary motion, transition
- absolute end frame and settled hold
- likely model failures and negative constraints

## Final review

Confirm complete narration coverage, asset identity, historical integrity, reference limit, visual closure at every boundary, no generated text, and no background music.
